services.name: Pumpkin Succulent Class
services.desc: Join us for an evening of creative living art. You will receive either one medium size pumpkin OR 3 mini pumpkins and plenty of succulent choices to create your masterpiece. This is an interactive class filled with artistic and innovative designs while getting your hands a little dirty. Fun for all ages and experience. Proceeds from the evening will support and enhance the Farm Museum’s educational programming, helping us continue to connect generations to Carroll County’s rich agricultural heritage. services.name: 2026 Summer Camps
services.desc: Perfect for preschool through first grade, Little Homesteaders is a joyful morning of play, discovery, and imagination. Young campers will try simple chores, hear stories from long ago, create hands-on crafts, and explore what daily life was like on a homestead. Designed just for our youngest learners, this gentle program encourages curiosity, cooperation, and lots of smiles as children discover the fun side of history. From seed to supper, campers will explore how agriculture helped nourish and support an entire community.
